title: Replace landing page car image with a tuner import style car

requirements.text: Replace the existing car image on the landing page hero section with a newly generated tuner import style car image. Use the generated image asset from frontend/public/assets/generated and render it in LandingPage.tsx.

quotes: Make the picture of the car on the landing page a tuner import style car

acceptanceCriteria: The landing page displays a tuner/import style car image (e.g., lowered Japanese sport compact with aftermarket body kit, wide-body styling, racing livery, or similar JDM/import tuner aesthetic)
The old car image is replaced by the new generated image
The image renders correctly across desktop and mobile viewports

constraints: Do not modify files listed in frontend.immutablePaths
Only LandingPage.tsx and the image asset need to change
nonGoals: Redesigning the overall landing page layout or hero section
Changing any other images or visual assets across the app

required: A sleek lowered JDM tuner import style sport car with aftermarket wide-body kit, large aftermarket wheels, aggressive front splitter, and colorful racing livery under dramatic studio-style lighting (tuner-car-hero.dim_1200x600.png)
